description.text:
Twelve oversized cards packed in sealed booster boxes of the three e-Card Series expansions, a reward for buying the whole box. They are numbered 01/12 to 12/12: Alakazam, Feraligatr, Tyranitar and Venusaur came in Expedition Base Set boxes, from 15 September 2002; Entei, Espeon, Scizor and Suicune in Aquapolis boxes; and Charizard, Crobat, Ho-Oh and Kabutops in Skyridge boxes, from 12 May 2003. Skyridge was the last expansion Wizards of the Coast made before it lost the license.

Box Toppers began with four oversized reverse holo cards in Legendary Collection. From EX Team Magma vs Team Aqua they became regular-sized cards with a design of their own, until EX Holon Phantoms, and they came back nearly 20 years later in the Enhanced Booster Display Boxes of Journey Together.

description.text: One of the twelve oversized box toppers of Wizards of the Coast's e-Card series: every English booster box came with one lying on top of its packs, numbered in their own run of twelve. Expedition Base Set boxes held the first four, 1/12 to 4/12: Alakazam, Feraligatr, Tyranitar and Venusaur; this is Alakazam, 1/12. PSA grades them as a set of their own, Expedition Box Topper. Since they slid around loose on top of the packs, many have small dings.

description.text: One of the twelve oversized box toppers of Wizards of the Coast's e-Card series: every English booster box came with one lying on top of its packs, numbered in their own run of twelve. Skyridge, released in May 2003 as the last set Wizards made, held the final four, 9/12 to 12/12: jumbo versions of four of its secret rare Crystal cards, Charizard, Crobat, Ho-oh and Kabutops; this is Charizard, 9/12. Unlike the cardboard toppers of Expedition and Aquapolis, these are printed on clear, see-through plastic.
